headlines.description: — Beck Malenstyn scored a spectacular goal, Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen made 28 saves and the Buffalo Sabres beat the Eastern Conference-leading Carolina Hurricanes 4-1 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beck Malenstyn's spectacular goal helps Sabres beat East-leading Hurricanes 4-1

headlines.description: — Jesper Wallstedt made 32 saves for his NHL-leading third shutout — all in the last four games — and the Minnesota Wild beat the Winnipeg Jets 3-0 on Sunday for their fifth straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wallstedt has 3rd shutout in 4 games, Wild beat Jets 3-0 for 5th straight victory

events.name: Seattle Kraken at New York Islanders

headlines.description: — Bo Horvat kept New York alive in the third round of a shootout and Kyle Palmieri scored in the fourth to back David Rittich in the Islanders' 1-0 victory over the Seattle Kraken on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Horvat, Palmieri score in shootout to back Rittich in Islanders' 1-0 victory over Kraken

headlines.description: — Scott Wedgewood made 22 saves for his first shutout and the Colorado Avalanche extended their winning streak to nine games with a 1-0 victory over the Chicago Blackhawks on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wedgewood, Makar lead NHL-best Avalanche to 9th straight win, 1-0 over Blackhawks

events.name: Boston Bruins at San Jose Sharks

headlines.description: — Macklin Celebrini scored his team-leading 14th goal of the season, and the San Jose Sharks beat the Boston Bruins 3-1 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Celebrini notches 14th goal, Sharks beat Bruins 3-1

headlines.description: — Dustin Wolf made 28 saves, defenseman Rasmus Andersson helped set up three goals and the Calgary Flames beat the Vancouver Canucks 5-2 on Sunday night for their third straight victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Flames beat Canucks 5-2 to finish back-to-back set with 3rd straight win
